description: Log in to ArkCase as 'arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com' (password: 'ArkCase1234!'). Locate the complaint case titled 'Improper Records Retention Complaint'. This case involves a report about the Office of Administrative Services failing to retain correspondence. Once found, subscribe to (or 'Follow') this case to receive notifications about future updates. Verify that the subscription is active by checking for the visual indicator (e.g., a filled star, bell icon, or 'Unsubscribe' option).
